`ai-sdks.js` is a browser bundle of two official SDKs, built from `web/` with `npm run build`:

- `@anthropic-ai/sdk` 1.6.0, Apache License 2.0, https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript
- `openai` 7.53.0, Apache License 2.0, https://github.com/openai/openai-node

Rebuild it rather than editing it by hand.
